text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-san. Won't you stay and hang 
out a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Bubble Gum Fellow gestured 
toward an atmospheric amusement arcade.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I come to places like this sometimes. My 
father taught me all sorts of games since 
I was little, you see."
choice_data_list_en: Sounds great, absolutely!
Sounds great, definitely!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Darts, mahjong, poker, hanafuda... I love 
'em all, but today I'm in the mood for—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Maybe this one? Trainer, are you good at 
billiards?
choice_data_list:
I've done it before, but that's about 
it...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I see, then let's start with a review. 
I'll teach you!
choice_data_list: やったことはある、くらいかな……
choice_data_list_en: I've done it before, I guess……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I grip the cue and hit a few balls. As I 
play casually while being taught, my feel 
for the game gradually returns!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, not bad, not bad at all! Hehe, now 
I'm getting fired up.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Well, how about we get serious now? 
Nine-ball. One rack to start, how's that 
sound?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's get banking right away!
choice_data_list_en: Yeah... Let's do it!
Yeah... Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nine-ball is a game where you aim for the 
balls in order, starting from the lowest 
number.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first player to pocket the 9-ball 
wins. Before long, they were down to the 
5-ball.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Ngh! Ah, couldn't sink it into the 
pocket, huh! Your turn next, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This ball arrangement...! If I can bounce 
the cue ball off the opposite cushion just 
right, I should be able to hit the 5 into 
the 9 and sink it in the pocket."
choice_data_list_en: All right! Wait...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: You noticed, huh...? *giggle*
choice_data_list: （大チャンスだ。これはいける……！）
choice_data_list_en: (This is a huge chance. We can do this...!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Trainer, are you confident we can win?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being asked makes me startle. Because I 
couldn't answer immediately, even though 
my heart felt, "I can do this!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, just the other day 
too... I was certain of it, yet I couldn't 
bring myself to say it out loud.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to be able to say it. Just like 
Bubble Gum Fellow...! I took a light 
breath and parted my lips.
choice_data_list_en: I—
I—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Give it a try!
choice_data_list_en: I'll sink the 9 ball and beat you!
I'll sink the 9 ball and defeat you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hold the cue and focus my mind. It's 
okay. I can do this... Because "I know I 
can"—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BONK! Clack, clack... THUD!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Splendid...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Ah ha ha ha! You look so happy!
choice_data_list_en: I did it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was truly exhilarating. To see 
something through exactly as promised... I 
never knew it could bring such a sense of 
pride.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, are you starting to act like me? 
Just kidding♪"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
You're so dependable right now. It's 
really cool.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Being told that so shamelessly makes my 
cheeks burn. I guess I really have 
changed, even if just a little...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Being told that so shamelessly makes my 
cheeks burn. I guess I really have 
changed, even if just a little...!"

choice_data_list_en: Putting it into words is important, isn't it?
Saying it out loud is really important, isn't it?
Winning today was all thanks to you.
Winning today was all thanks to you.
I'll work even harder from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'm sure you understand by 
now.

choice_data_list_en: Putting it into words is important, isn't it?
Saying it out loud is really important, isn't it?
Winning today was all thanks to you.
Winning today was all thanks to you.
I'll work even harder from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'm declaring it because I know I can do 
it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod deeply at those words. I felt as 
though I had gained a renewed, deeper 
understanding of Bubble Gum Fellow's 
indomitable spirit.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Thanks to me...?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Could that be about the amusement park or 
the BBQ?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being with Bubble Gum Fellow makes me want 
to stand tall alongside her cool self. 
That helped me grow just a little bit.
choice_data_list_en: Right, your influence.
Right, because of your influence.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Chuckle. I didn't do anything at all. 
If anything has changed, that's your own 
power.
choice_data_list_en: So, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to the strength of the 
Trainer I chose and believed in!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I'm counting on you. I'll have to 
do my best to live up to your expectations 
too♪

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
First, I'm going to beat you this time! 
Let's go for one more match!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we played games right up until 
curfew. A heated, serious match...! I was 
truly happy to have a relationship where 
we could do that.
choice_data_list_en: Bring it on!
Bring it on!
